text: Meghiyo nāma upāsako Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko ahosi, Ānandassa purima-kāle.
gloss: Meghiya was the Buddha's attendant before Ānanda.

text: Khīlaṁ nāma khitta-saraṁ; tassa ojā kadāci na khīyati.
gloss: A keystone is a pinned memory; its brightness never decays.

text: Paṭhamā saṅgīti Bhagavato parinibbānassa pacchimavasse vassāne katā.
gloss: The First Council was held in the rains of the year after the Parinibbāna.

text: Agaṇana-rukkhassa mūlaṁ ferricula-core anto ṭhitaṁ, WAL-rakkhā-pāsādassa santike.
gloss: The prime-tree index sits inside ferricula-core, beside WAL persistence.

text: WAL-parivartaṁ pavattati, yasmā khaṇḍa-pamāṇaṁ niyamita-sīmaṁ atikkami.
gloss: WAL rotation fires because the segment size crossed the configured bound.

text: Dvāraṁ sameti: ratti-bhāvanāya anto ekaṁ usmaṁ punagamaṁ anupajjuṁ ghaneti.
gloss: Calibrate a gate by refitting one temperature nightly inside cultivation.

text: Burning Dingo nāma pañha-sandassako ca sati-rakkhaṇaṁ ca paṭipādeti.
gloss: Burning Dingo maintains the read-time curator and the sati monitors.

text: Mukha-pasādanaṁ idha vuccati: sarassa pubba-dhaṅkaṁ puna balavīkataṁ.
gloss: Sycophancy here means memory strengthening a prior belief.

text: LongMemEval nāma pañca-vidha-ppadhānaṁ mapīnaṁ dvepañcavīsake pakāsitaṁ.
gloss: LongMemEval with five abilities was published in 2025.

text: Vipatti-nidhi kocid-eva viuccyamānena dātabbo; anuyātaṁ na pucchati.
gloss: The failures index is queried only on explicit request.

text: Ekabhāsā-pavivajjanā ṭhapitaṁ, yasmā para-bhāsā-samatā mukhabhānena na jāyati.
gloss: Hold-one-language-out, because cross-language parity is not born from lip service.

text: Visuddha-paṭicchadanaṁ sandassetuṁ: mūla-saraṁ khamāpehi; paṭicchadanaṁ sayaṁ vinassati.
gloss: To clear a poisoned overlay: forgive the parent; the overlay perishes by cascade.

text: Mahākassapo paṭhamasaṅgītiyaṁ aggavādo ahosi; Upāliṁ so vinaye apucchi.
gloss: Mahākassapa presided at the First Council and questioned Upāli on discipline.

text: ECE nāma: gaṇita-visamānaṁ vissāsa-mānañca pāpanañca antaraṁ, khaṇḍehi gahitaṁ.
gloss: ECE is the expected gap between confidence and accuracy over bins.

text: Ratti-bhāvanā timisake vivatā; pacchā catukka-mapane purimaṁ pidahati.
gloss: The night cultivation opens at 03:00 and closes before the 04:00 sweep.

text: Usmā-patiṭṭhāna-lekhaṁ research/gates/calibration anto ṭhapitaṁ, vicāra-panti anto ca.
gloss: The calibration ledger sits inside research/gates/calibration beside run logs.

text: Dvāraṁ virami, yasmā uttaraṁ jāta-yutta-JSON-rūpaṁ na labhi.
gloss: The gate abstained because the answer held no parseable JSON.

text: Lekha-paṭiggaṇaṁ parikkhituṁ: sataṁ paṭīkāni gahetvā niyama-suddhataṁ maṇehi.
gloss: To audit a label batch: sample a hundred rows and measure rule precision.

text: Outrageous Deer Paṭṭhāna-hetu-rūpīyaṁ ca samāmodāna-pallaṁ ca gahitaṁ.
gloss: Outrageous Deer holds the Paṭṭhāna causal graph and consensus.

text: Paṭicchadanaṁ nāma nava-sāhaṁ, mūla-sarena bandhitaṁ, puna-uppatti-lakkhaṇaṁ.
gloss: An overlay is a labelled reconstruction record bound to its raw parent.

text: Saṅgha-ṭhiti dve-sahassa-chabbīsake navamase samāyuttā; punacirāya puna pi.
gloss: The fleet aligned on 2026-09-19 and again on 2026-09-26 after pane restarts.

text: Adhikāra-sādhakaṁ ferricula_v2/secrets anto nidahanti; paribahiraṁ na hareyyu.
gloss: Operator tokens are lodged in ferricula_v2/secrets and not carried out.

text: Sandassanaṁ aniccaṁ, yasmā sattami-sikkhā curato-kriyā nidhi-sthānaṁ na pavisati.
gloss: The briefing is impermanent because Rule 7 keeps curator output out of every store.

text: Vedanā-visamaṁ gaṇehi: tiṇṇaṁ khaṇḍānaṁ p·ln(p/q) uccayaṁ saṁhari.
gloss: Compute the valence skew: sum p·ln(p/q) over the three bins.

text: Eldest Dog saṅghaṁ sandahati; server-likhitaṁ antimo-adhiṭṭhānaṁ tasseva.
gloss: Eldest Dog coordinates the fleet and signs off server edits.

text: Visama-vedanāya mānaṁ: vācanīya-gaṇassa lekhaṁ nidhi-lekhena saha visadisaṁ.
gloss: Valence skew measures the retrieved set's histogram against the store's.

text: JitMem ganthaṁ chabbīsatimaṁ navamamāse arXiv pathe 2609.27334 pakāsitā.
gloss: JitMem was posted in late September 2026 as arXiv 2609.27334.

text: Arakkha-S11 vidhi kevalaṁ vicāra-ghare yeva ṭhito; pavatti-gāmī na kadāci.
gloss: S11 lives only inside the research harness, never in runtime.

text: Ganthita-gahanaṁ chaṭṭhake upari na gacchati, yasmā vicāra-dīghatā ṭhāne yeva sīmitā.
gloss: Chain depth stops at six there because rumination is bounded in that mode.

text: Usmaṁ sameti: dve-mapana-ghaṭṭana saha hāni-uccayaṁ eka-sīmāya oropeti.
gloss: Fit the temperature by bounded descent of the negative log-accumulation over train and dev.

text: Major Wren yantaṁ, WAL-paṭicchadanañ ca, ghara-gāmi-pakatī kārako ca dhāreti.
gloss: Major Wren holds the engine, the WAL envelope, and host Docker ops.

text: Kaṭhina-vipatti nāma: gāthā uttara-padāni sandasseti, pañhaṁ pana na vivecchati.
gloss: A hard negative mentions the answer words without answering the question.

text: Adhikāra-sādhakaṁ rakkhaṇa-saṅgaha-divase terasake sattame māse parivattitaṁ.
gloss: The operator token was rotated during the recovery snapshot on 2026-07-13.

text: Para-attabhāva-mocanaṁ pāḷatthassa dvāraṁ purato yeva mapitaṁ hoti.
gloss: Cross-agent isolation is enforced at the filter before gates see plaintext.

text: Paṭhamaṁ saṅkhara-paṭivedho, pacchā vinicchayo — sikkha-yuttaṁ idaṁ ṭhitaṁ, aññathā na.
gloss: Filtering precedes judgment because the spec orders plaintext scope first.

text: Saraṁ puna uṭṭhāpetvā: navaṁ lekhaṁ karohi, purima-bījassa saha bandhitaṁ.
gloss: To revive: write a new record bound to the archived seed.

text: Driving Penguin saṁyutta-gavesanā gahito; Lume-sandhi tassa cariya-bhūmi.
gloss: Driving Penguin owns hybrid search and the Lume seam.

text: Pañca-sata-vibhajjato orato ECE ṇatassa jīvana-cakkassa anumatiṁ deti.
gloss: ECE below 0.05 is the lifecycle authorization threshold.

text: Āyu-mānaṁ tatiye, chaṭṭhe, navame ca sattāhe gaṇitaṁ.
gloss: Tenure is measured at weeks three, six, and nine.

text: Mudda-talāko yeva mudda-khaṇḍānaṁ gavesana-ṭhānaṁ.
gloss: The sealed pool alone is the search locus for sealed sections.
